title: Barcelona private tour by car.
text:
We booked Daniel for a private car tour of Barcelona as we only had limited time and had no idea of ‘comme il faut’ there.

Great decision on our part! Whilst driving around city highlights, Daniel shared his knowledge in fluent English and we gained an insight into local culture and Catalonian history. It was more like  chatting with an old friend, Daniel’s personable, outgoing nature and his obvious pride in his city were so endearing.
We thoroughly recommend this tour!
author: F7790LOchrish

title: Private tour
text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
We had an amazing tour with Daniel. I was traveling with my wife and our two toddlers, and he made the entire experience smooth, fun, and incredibly informative. He was patient, kind, and went out of his way to make sure everyone even the little ones felt comfortable and engaged. His knowledge of the area was impressive, and he had a great way of sharing history and stories that kept us all interested. Highly recommend Daniel if you’re looking for a thoughtful, professional, and genuinely friendly tour guide!
author: Badoski99

title: Knowledgeable, friendly and positive vibe
text: We spent a day with Daniel in his great black van with my two teenagers and had a fantastic discussion about everything there is to know regarding Barcelona. I really appreciate that he fielded questions from us with ease about anything from economics to culture and education, helping us understand the makings of the local scene. English was solid, very positive outlook on life and time well spent!
author: lendenw
